component.name: Proton VPN
component.summary: Official Proton VPN app for Linux desktop

description.p: Proton VPN is a privacy-focused VPN client for Linux. It lets you securely connect to Proton VPN servers and manage your VPN connection from a native GTK desktop application.
Sign in with your Proton account to access server locations, connect and disconnect with one click, and use account features provided by Proton VPN.
